fusions.name: Quick Nick
fusions.desc: A quick strike with your weapon that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrown from Cover
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Throws a hidden blade that deals 24 damage, with 50% more critical chance against a target nothing has wounded yet.

fusions.name: Blend In
fusions.desc: You are veiled for 8 seconds, enemies notice you 70% later, and you move 10% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Back to Stillness
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next strike has 20% more critical chance. Once every 10 seconds.
